## Requirements

- [ ] Directory contains `manifest.toml` and `README.md`
- [ ] Entry added to `.github/CODEOWNERS`
- [ ] README index regenerated (`python3 .github/scripts/generate_index.py`)
- [ ] License is MIT, or declared via SPDX headers or a local `REUSE.toml`
- [ ] No dependencies on other tools in this repository
- [ ] Tested against the SwayFX version in `swayfx_tested`
- [ ] Patches apply with `git am --3way` (patches only)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] I will keep this tool current, or it will be marked unmaintained
